name: B10-0227/2024 (Renew) – Human rights situation in Kyrgyzstan, in particular the case of Temirlan Sultanbekov
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the human rights situation in Kyrgyzstan, in particular the case of Temirlan Sultanbekov
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is asking Kyrgyzstan to release opposition leader Temirlan Sultanbekov and other people held for their political views. It says his health is getting worse and his family cannot visit him. It also asks the European Union to put pressure on Kyrgyzstan, including possible sanctions and a review of trade benefits, if the situation gets worse.

- The Parliament asks Kyrgyzstan to free Sultanbekov and other political prisoners; nothing changes automatically.
- It affects Kyrgyzstan's government and opposition figures, journalists and activists there.
- Next, the EU delegation and Commission are urged to raise the case and review trade benefits.
